mapper.select: SELECT m.company_name, m.department_name, m.last_name, m.first_name, m.email, m.daytime_phone AS phone FROM members m WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.member_status = 'active'

INSERT INTO inquiries ( member_id, company_name, department_name, last_name, first_name, email, phone, inquiry_type, order_phase, product_name, product_code, message, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{form.companyName}, #{form.departmentName}, #{form.lastName}, #{form.firstName}, #{form.email}, #{form.phone}, #{form.inquiryType}, #{form.orderPhase}, #{form.productName}, #{form.productCode}, #{form.message}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING inquiry_id
